_comment: Pattern 5 mutation run over chat-types' IMPERATIVE protocol helpers that sit OUTSIDE the existing padding.ts blocking target — the residual behaviour-bearing logic in this single-source-of-truth package. native-web-search.ts (the native web-search error classifier — which provider errors map to capability-rejection vs preoutput-failure vs auth/quota fall-through, a contract consumed by web+mobile+enclave), file-capabilities.ts (the extension->capability-family lookup behind the file-tools surface), and calypso-follow-up.ts (the follow-up message-history builder whose private-derived omission gate is a masking-roundtrip / privacy invariant).
